dslRule:
<!id: arrays.getStackTrace.toString>
<!description: Replaces direct toString() call on a StackTraceElement[] array with Arrays.toString() to print array contents instead of identity hash code.>
<!severity: WARNING>
$exception.getStackTrace() :: instanceof($exception, "java.lang.Throwable")
=>
java.util.Arrays.toString($exception.getStackTrace())
;;
